output.notes: Described the 2B config in block_ops; the 9B and 27B configs differ only in sizes (Table 1). Which layers are local and which global, and which comes first, is not stated. 'Feedforward dim' is reported as written (18432 for 2B, 8x d_model). It may count gate and up together, but the paper does not say so. The embedding scaling, final norm, RoPE theta and pairing, norm eps, biases and attention scale are not stated; no final norm is added in the head. Residual adds are taken from the declared Transformer basis. The attention op is marked unsupported because of the 50.0 logit soft-cap.
